notes.title: Glory to the Heroes!
notes.content:
A brand new update just landed on Steam!
Heroes joined Multiplayer duels and this is what they bring to the game:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28748587/034c6f41fe2d7079c5b2603b001c421fd557519b.jpg[/img]

Heroes are squads containing of a single pawn, which doesn’t have a morale bar, and so, doesn’t suffer from morale loss. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28748587/b96c61ff65d1173d691863a62aecb32ab356df8b.jpg[/img]

On the other hand, Heroes have special aura indicated by big blue circle around them, which, once players food drop to zero, prevents other squads morale loss from hunger. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28748587/46c2a237fe5ec25307f260caf7e8a4d32454f20c.jpg[/img]

Heroes cannot be replenished or re-recruited when they die.

Haven’t registered for the tournament yet? No worries, you still have time as epic battles will start on August 25 th .
Follow this link: https://battlefy.com/the-overpowered-noobs/ancestors-legacy-medieval-clash-of-swords-supported-by-amd-powered-by-opnoobs-esports-4indie/5b6355f1cae55603af211eca/info?infoTab=details for all the details and apply today for a chance to win your very own,
powerful AMD Ryzen CPU and Ancestors Legacy Collector’s Edition!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28748587/66a6dc2a77be3d482f7bff19d41622633673e898.jpg[/img]

Patch Notes:
- Added heroes in multiplayer games -  they are on by default, but you can turn them off in while setting up multiplayer/skirmish game
- Added system for reporting players
- Added spectators info on MP loading screen
- Spectators can now turn on Action Camera - simply by pressing Action Camera key while cursor is hovering over squad
- Some fixes to AI logic
- Arrow Rain ability can be used now when movement is blocked.
- Fixed poorly looking warehouse in mission "Holmgard"
- Some improvements in catapult movement
- Dedicated server will now refresh themself every few hours. This way they will avoid going into blocked state after spending too much time in idle
- Proper clearing game data when player try to join other game from endscreen
- Some fixes to pop ups shown after Alt+F4
- Fixed issue with taking ownership of base when squad is inside - rerecruit did not work correctly in this case
- Fixed issue with banners colours and player name when AI took over for player who leave game
- Few weird crashes fixed
